from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "First, we take a random sample of size n.",
            "Next, we calculate the average for that sample.",
            "We repeat this process hundreds or thousands of times.",
            "Each sample mean is plotted on a new graph.",
            "This builds the sampling distribution of the mean."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Experiment: The Sampling Process", lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_SAMPLE = BLUE_B
        COLOR_AVG = "#FFFF00"
        COLOR_AXIS = WHITE
        COLOR_POP = GREY_B

        # 1. Background Setup: Source Population
        population = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.04, color=COLOR_POP) for _ in range(80)])
        population.arrange_in_grid(rows=8, cols=10, buff=0.15)
        self.place_in_area(population, "A2", "B5", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.add(population)

        pop_label = Text("Source Population", font_size=16, color=COLOR_POP)
        self.place_at_grid(pop_label, "A1", scale_factor=0.8)

        # 2. Setup Axis for Distribution
        axis = NumberLine(
            x_range=[0, 10, 1],
            length=5,
            color=COLOR_AXIS,
            include_numbers=False,
            include_tip=True
        )
        self.place_in_area(axis, "F2", "F5", scale_factor=1.0)
        axis_label = Text("Sampling Distribution of the Mean", font_size=16, color=COLOR_AXIS)
        self.place_at_grid(axis_label, "E1", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.add(axis)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # First, we take a random sample of size n.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_SAMPLE)
        
        # Select n random dots from population to highlight
        sample_indices = np.random.choice(len(population), 15, replace=False)
        highlighted_dots = VGroup(*[population[i] for i in sample_indices])
        
        sample_box = SurroundingRectangle(highlighted_dots, color=COLOR_SAMPLE, buff=0.1)
        sample_label = Text("n=15", font_size=18, color=COLOR_SAMPLE).next_to(sample_box, RIGHT)
        
        self.play(
            highlighted_dots.animate.set_color(COLOR_SAMPLE).scale(1.3),
            Create(sample_box),
            Write(sample_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Next, we calculate the average for that sample.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_AVG)
        
        avg_text = MathTex(r"\text{Average} = \bar{x}", color=COLOR_AVG, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(avg_text, "C3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(avg_text), run_time=0.8)
        self.play(Indicate(avg_text, color=COLOR_AVG), run_time=1)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # (Plotting first mean)
        # Each sample mean is plotted on a new graph.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_AVG)
        
        first_mean_val = 5.2
        first_dot = Dot(color=COLOR_AVG, radius=0.06).move_to(axis.n2p(first_mean_val))
        
        self.play(
            ReplacementTransform(avg_text.copy(), first_dot),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # We repeat this process hundreds or thousands of times.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_SAMPLE)
        
        # Clean up labels for repeat animation
        self.play(FadeOut(sample_box), FadeOut(sample_label), FadeOut(avg_text))
        
        # Repeated samples appearing and transforming into dots
        for _ in range(4):
            # Flash a new sample
            new_indices = np.random.choice(len(population), 15, replace=False)
            new_sample = VGroup(*[population[i].copy().set_color(COLOR_SAMPLE).scale(1.3) for i in new_indices])
            new_val = np.random.normal(5, 0.7)
            new_dot = Dot(color=COLOR_AVG, radius=0.06).move_to(axis.n2p(new_val))
            
            self.play(
                FadeIn(new_sample, run_time=0.2),
                ReplacementTransform(new_sample, new_dot, run_time=0.4),
            )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # This builds the sampling distribution of the mean.
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        
        # Massive drop of dots
        remaining_dots = VGroup()
        n_dots = 120
        # Calculate positions in a bell curve shape
        bins = np.zeros(20)
        for _ in range(n_dots):
            val = np.random.normal(5, 0.7)
            # Find bin
            bin_idx = int(np.clip((val - 2) * 4, 0, 19))
            height = bins[bin_idx]
            bins[bin_idx] += 1
            
            dot_pos = axis.n2p(2 + bin_idx/4) + UP * (height * 0.1)
            dot = Dot(color=COLOR_AVG, radius=0.04, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(dot_pos)
            remaining_dots.add(dot)
            
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(d) for d in remaining_dots], lag_ratio=0.02),
            run_time=3
        )
        
        # Final normal distribution curve
        dist_curve = axis.get_graph(
            lambda x: 1.5 * np.exp(-0.5 * ((x - 5) / 0.7)**2),
            color=WHITE,
            x_range=[2.5, 7.5]
        )
        self.play(Create(dist_curve), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout
        title = Text("The Central Limit Theorem (CLT)", font_size=32, color=BLUE).to_edge(UP)
        
        lecture_lines = [
            "1. Take samples from ANY distribution.",
            "2. Calculate the average of each sample.",
            "3. The distribution of these averages...",
            "4. ...will always be Normal (Bell Curve)!"
        ]
        
        lecture_vgroup = VGroup(*[
            Text(line, font_size=20).arrange(RIGHT, aligned_edge=LEFT) 
            for line in lecture_lines
        ]).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN*0.5)

        self.play(Write(title))
        self.play(FadeIn(lecture_vgroup, shift=RIGHT))
        self.wait(1)

        # 2. Visual Representation Area (Right Side)
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 10, 2],
            y_range=[0, 1, 0.5],
            x_length=5,
            y_length=3,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "font_size": 18}
        ).to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.8).shift(UP*0.5)
        
        labels = axes.get_axis_labels(x_label="Value", y_label="Prob")
        
        # Original Distribution: Uniform
        uniform_dist = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.2 if 1 <= x <= 9 else 0, color=YELLOW, x_range=[0, 10])
        dist_label = Text("Uniform Distribution", font_size=18, color=YELLOW).next_to(axes, DOWN)

        self.play(Create(axes), Write(labels))
        self.play(Create(uniform_dist), Write(dist_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # 3. Sampling Animation
        dots = VGroup(*[Dot(axes.c2p(np.random.uniform(1, 9), 0.2), color=WHITE, radius=0.04) for _ in range(20)])
        sample_text = Text("Sampling...", font_size=18).next_to(dist_label, DOWN)
        
        self.play(Write(sample_text))
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(dot) for dot in dots], lag_ratio=0.05))
        self.play(FadeOut(dots), FadeOut(uniform_dist), FadeOut(dist_label))

        # 4. Final Result: Normal Distribution
        # The CLT states that the distribution of means approaches a normal distribution
        mu = 5
        sigma = 1.2
        normal_dist = axes.plot(
            lambda x: (1 / (sigma * np.sqrt(2 * np.pi))) * np.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma)**2),
            color=GREEN,
            x_range=[0, 10]
        )
        result_label = Text("Distribution of Sample Means (Normal)", font_size=18, color=GREEN).next_to(axes, DOWN)

        self.play(Create(normal_dist), Write(result_label))
        self.play(Indicate(lecture_vgroup[-1], color=GREEN))
        self.wait(2)

        # Cleanup
        self.play(
            FadeOut(title),
            FadeOut(lecture_vgroup),
            FadeOut(axes),
            FadeOut(labels),
            FadeOut(normal_dist),
            FadeOut(result_label),
            FadeOut(sample_text)
        )
